builds.name: Death Mark: recorded finite-combo detonation
builds.summary: Investigate high one Death Mark pop after a recorded three-second combo output with a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate high one Death Mark pop after a recorded three-second combo output with a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: R lists a 1.0 total AD physical base plus 25/40/55% of eligible damage dealt during its three-second mark. The actual stored-damage rules, pre/post-mitigation basis and item/passive eligibility must be measured. A larger pop is not obtained by inventing an arbitrary stored damage number or adding the entire setup combo again.

ceiling.targetName: one Death Mark pop after a recorded three-second combo
ceiling.finiteState: Level 18, selected ability maximum learned rank unless explicitly overridden, minute 30. Enemy champion: 20000 maximum HP, 100 armor and 50 MR. Owner HP 100%, target HP 100%, observation 4s. No dragons, elixirs or allied stat buffs. Record actual AD/AP, HP and resist modifiers; Gathering Storm at minute 30 if selected. No free permanent stacks. Stop damage at death, cap healing at recipient missing HP, and report raw output separately. Exactly 10 earned Hubris kills with temporary buff active. One legal W shadow plus the R shadow, one E, one Q cast with up to three actually connected shurikens, and at most two real basic attacks during the mark. Target 20000 maximum HP, initially full. Record exact events before the three-second cutoff; observe through the pop within four seconds. No Hydra active or free extra resets.

kitEvidence.formula:
Zed becomes Untargetable and dashes to an enemy champion, marking them. After [3] seconds, the mark triggers, dealing [(1) × AD] physical damage and repeating [(0.25 / 0.4 / 0.55) × 100]% of all damage dealt to the target by Zed while the mark was active.

The dash leaves a Shadow behind for [7.5] seconds. Zed can Recast this Ability to switch positions with this Shadow.
